prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production transparent animation sprite atlas for Little King. The input image is the reference for ONE existing character or building identity. Preserve its exact outfit, face, colours, species, weapons and silhouette. Warm hand-painted storybook gouache, clear chestnut outlines, pine green, parchment and antique gold, consistent with the input image. Output a SQUARE 2048x2048 RGBA sprite atlas containing EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, sixteen equal cells. Exactly ONE complete subject in each cell. Cell centres at 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% on each axis. Identical scale, camera and anchor across ALL cells. Upright figures use the SAME foot baseline and head size. Every weapon and appendage stays strictly INSIDE its own cell, with at least 10% transparent padding. Front three-quarter view toward screen right. Absolutely NO background, floor, shadows, grid lines, borders, numbers, letters or labels. True transparent alpha outside each figure. Frames read left to right and top to bottom. A monumental broad humanoid stone colossus constructed from warm cream limestone blocks, tiny calm amber eyes, square heavy fists, thick pillar legs, moss-green growth in joints and restrained antique-gold crown-like brow and chest plate. Ancient immensely heavy guardian, no weapons, no floating particles. Row 1: four subtle breathing idle frames with a gentle blink. Row 2: four clearly different walk-cycle frames (left stride, passing, right stride, passing). Row 3: four attack frames appropriate to its exact existing weapon: ready, windup or draw bow, strike or release, recover. Row 4: first two hit reaction frames (small recoil then recover); last two defeated/incapacitated poses (kneel then lie on side), no gore or blood. Independently draw genuine successive poses, not sixteen identical copies. No particles or large magic effects. Never crop limbs, weapon tips or the character. No pose crosses cell boundaries. Critical: no flying arrows, detached projectiles, dust or ground shadows. Each subject must fit inside a square cell with a wide 15% transparent margin on every side. Keep the SAME compact scale in all sixteen frames. Make all weapons and wings compact enough to fit fully.
